name: ghost-subtitles
description: Feel a conversation the way a beginner in a new language hears it. Live speech-to-text with a fluency slider that drops words, streamed over WebSockets to a second screen.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
